board: South Dakota Board of Accountancy (Department of Labor & Regulation)

cycle.note: South Dakota counts CPE in July 1 – June 30 years: 120 hours over the rolling three years and at least 20 each year. Certificates renew every year by August 1. There's no ethics requirement.

requirements.label: Three-year total
requirements.note: 120 hours in the three CPE years ending June 30 (SDCL 36-20B-27).

requirements.label: Minimum each year
requirements.note: At least 20 hours every CPE year (July 1 – June 30).

requirements.label: Behavioral or motivational
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. In public accounting, no more than 24 behavioral or motivational hours count per three years (ARSD 20:75:04:09). We count Personal Development courses.
requirements.otherLabel: Any course except behavioral or motivational

newLicensee.note: No CPE is due for the CPE year you were certified in. Then at least 20 hours a year; the 120 over three years applies from the third full year (ARSD 20:75:04:07).

licenseDateHint: South Dakota certificates renew every year by August 1 (enter 07/31). CPE years run July 1 – June 30.
issueDateHint: If you were certified this CPE year (since July 1), no CPE is due for it.
limitsNotTracked: University or college teaching: max 60 hours per three years.
Published work needs Board approval first.
Self-study and nano-learning must come from NASBA Registry sponsors.
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation in case of the Board's yearly audit (ARSD 20:75:04:14).
toVerify: The 20-hour yearly minimum comes from the Board FAQ, not the rule text.
How long records must be kept.
